overall_comment: The patient is a middle aged male with a large solitary glioma involving the temporal lobe cortex and extending into deep structures including the basal ganglia and thalamus with midline shift and ventricular effacement on the right side. The tumor shows marked enhancement with necrosis and deep white matter invasion as well as ependymal invasion.
